question:
The line chart given below shows the number of followers (in '000) on Instagram of a person in 6 consecutive months MT1, MT2, MT3, MT4, MT5 and MT6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0654e3fa65607b5cb1207cc51da61e8a81021513aa3b7785d70394bb24d278c.png] 

What is the average monthly increase in the number of followers of the person on the Instagram from MT1 to MT6?
solution:
**Given:**

 
 

 Month
 Number of Followers (in '000)
 
 

 MT1
 132
 
 

 MT2
 176
 
 

 MT3
 214
 
 

 MT4
 246
 
 

 MT5
 298
 
 

 MT6
 321
 
 

Unit scale: 1 unit = 1000 followers

**Formula Used:**

Total Increase = Followers at MT6 − Followers at MT1

Average Monthly Increase = Total Increase ÷ Number of monthly intervals (n − 1)

Total intervals from MT1 to MT6 = 6 − 1 = 5

**Calculation:**

According to the line chart,

⇒ Number of followers at MT1 = 132 × 1000 = 132000

⇒ Number of followers at MT6 = 321 × 1000 = 321000

⇒ Total increase in followers from MT1 to MT6 = 321000 − 132000 = 189000

⇒ Number of months of growth (intervals) = 5 (MT1 to MT2, MT2 to MT3, MT3 to MT4, MT4 to MT5, MT5 to MT6)

⇒ Average monthly increase = 189000 ÷ 5

⇒ Average monthly increase = 37800

∴ **The correct answer is 37800.**
